description: Sim 91 — CMSTG Lambda0 sensitivity scan. Maps how key observables (G_eff/G, growth factor ratio D_CMSTG/D_LCDM, sigma_8 ratio, H(z) deviation, BAO chi2, approximate CMB chi2) vary as Lambda0 is increased from 0 to 0.1. Identifies the Lambda0 threshold at which CMSTG becomes observationally distinguishable from LCDM. Provides the 'CMSTG signature map' for the paper's discussion section.

lambda0_scan.note: Log-spaced scan plus key values: 0.003 (BAO best-fit), 0.008 (joint best-fit)

base_cosmology.note: Joint CMB+BAO best-fit from SIM90. Used as the common background for all Lambda0 values so that only Lambda0 varies.

cmstg_field.note: Field parameters held fixed. Lambda form: Lambda0 * Psi^2 (SIM84-verified). G_eff = 1/(1+16pi*Lambda0*Psi^2).

integration.note: RK45 integration of CMSTG FLRW+scalar system (equations from SIM87/section3_lagrangian.tex)

sigma8.note: sigma_8 = sqrt(integral Pk * W^2(kR) k^2 dk / 2pi^2) with R=8 Mpc/h, top-hat W(x)=3(sin x - x cos x)/x^3. Uses CMSTG P(k) = LCDM P(k) * (D_CMSTG/D_LCDM)^2. LCDM P(k) from BBKS transfer function with Planck amplitude A_s=2.101e-9, n_s=0.9649.

observability_thresholds.note: Observable deviation thresholds: G_eff/G > 0.1% (strong lensing), D_ratio > 0.1% (structure growth surveys), sigma_8 ratio > 0.2% (cluster counts/WL), H(z) > 0.1% (future BAO, e.g. DESI)
